nodes.name: Error Trigger
nodes.notes: Catches ALL errors from ALL other workflows automatically. Set this as the error workflow in every workflow's settings.

nodes.name: Parse & Classify Error
nodes.notes: Extracts error details and assigns severity. Client-facing workflows = Critical.

nodes.name: Log to Error Sheet
nodes.notes: Writes every error to the Error Log sheet in Agency OS.

nodes.name: Alert Needed?
nodes.notes: Only send WhatsApp alert for Medium, High, and Critical errors. Low errors just log silently.

nodes.name: Alert via WhatsApp
nodes.notes: Sends immediate WhatsApp alert for non-low severity errors.
